y-m-44-02.title: Mwero kubva kuchiteshi che drone kuenda kunzira: mhinduro yakatadza papi?
y-m-44-02.topic: Mwero pakati pepoinzi nemutsara, uye mitsara miviri yakafanana iri pamwero wakaenzana
y-m-44-02.goal: Tsvaga mutsara apo mhinduro yemwero pakati pepoinzi nemutsara inotadza, tarisa mhedzisiro nenzira imwe, uye uwane kuti mapoinzi ari pamwero wakaenzana ari pamativi ose maviri enzira.
y-m-44-02.material: Chiteshi che drone P chiri pa (1, 5) pa coordinate plane (1 square = 1 km), uye equation yenzira yakatwasuka l ndi 3x + 4y − 30 = 0. Mudzidzi akaisa mhinduro ye 'mwero mupfupi zvakanyanya kubva ku P kuenda kunzira'.
y-m-44-02.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekutanga: fungidzira kuti mudzidzi akadzidza kamwe nzira yekutsvaga mwero pakati pepoinzi nemutsara uye anoziva zvinoreva absolute value.
y-m-44-02.s.s1.prompt: Pazasi pane mhinduro yemwero mupfupi zvakanyanya kubva pachiteshi che drone P(1, 5) kuenda kunzira l : 3x + 4y − 30 = 0. Sarudza mutsara wekutanga unotadza. (1 square = 1 km)
y-m-44-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa imwe neimwe kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe wakabva sei kumutsara uri pamusoro payo uye kuti nhamba dzakashandiswa dzinobva kupi.
y-m-44-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa ma coefficients mu equation yemutsara 3x + 4y − 30 = 0 nenhamba dziri mumutsara we3.
y-m-44-02.s.s1.line.0: Tsvaga mwero pakati pepoinzi P(1, 5) nemutsara 3x + 4y − 30 = 0.
y-m-44-02.s.s1.line.1: Kuisa ma coordinates epoinzi kudivi rekuruboshwe re equation yemutsara kunopa 3·1 + 4·5 − 30 = −7.
y-m-44-02.s.s1.line.2: Denominator inogadzirwa kubva ku ma coefficients: √(3 + 4) = √7.
y-m-44-02.s.s1.line.4: Saka mwero kubva ku P kuenda kumutsara ndi √7 (anenge 2.65).
y-m-44-02.s.s1.explain: Inotadza pamutsara we3. Denominator inoita square coefficient 3 ye x ne coefficient 4 ye y uye ichiwedzera: √(3² + 4²) = 5. √(3 + 4) yakakanganwa kuita square. Saka mwero ndi 7 ÷ 5 = 1.4 km. Mitsara 4 ne5 yakashata nekuti yakagara nhaka kukosha kwakashata kubva mumutsara we3.
y-m-44-02.s.s2.prompt: Unoda kutarisa kana mhedzisiro yemhinduro ye √7 km yakarurama nenzira yakasiyana, usingadzokorore kuverenga kumwe chete. Sarudza nzira dzose dzinogona kushandiswa kutonga zvakaparadzana kana mhedzisiro yakarurama.
y-m-44-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tonga kana nzira imwe neimwe i 'nzira yakasiyana' kubva kumhinduro yekutanga kana kuti kungodzokorora kuverenga kumwe chete.
y-m-44-02.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti 'mwero mupfupi zvakanyanya' unofanira kugutsa chimiro chipi zvichienzaniswa nepoinzi ipi neipi iri panzira.
y-m-44-02.s.s2.o.a: Verenga kamwe zvakare nerongedzero imwe chete nemhinduro yekutanga uye uenzanise kana makosha maviri akaenzana
y-m-44-02.s.s2.r.a: Kudzokorora rongedzero imwe chete kunoita kukanganisa kumwe chete zvakare. Unoda nzira yakasiyana.
y-m-44-02.s.s2.o.b: Wisa perpendicular kubva ku P kuenda kunzira, ichisangana nayo papoinzi H, uye uyere mwero PH zvakananga
y-m-44-02.s.s2.r.b: Kutarisa kwakanaka. Poinzi iri panzira iri padhuze zvakanyanya ne P ndiyo tsoka ye perpendicular, saka mwero kuenda kupoinzi iyoyo ndiko kukosha kwaunoda chaizvo.
y-m-44-02.s.s2.o.c: Yera mwero kubva ku P kuenda kupoinzi (10, 0), apo nzira inosangana ne x-axis, uye utarise kana yakaenzana ne √7
y-m-44-02.s.s2.r.c: (10, 0) ipoinzi imwe chete iri panzira, pasina chivimbiso chekuti ndiyo iri padhuze zvakanyanya. Haungashamise kana ikasiyana nemwero mupfupi zvakanyanya.
y-m-44-02.s.s2.o.d: Tarisa kana mwero kuenda kupoinzi imwe iri panzira inoratidzika padhuze ne P ichipfupika kupfuura √7
y-m-44-02.s.s2.r.d: Hapana poinzi iri panzira inogona kuva padhuze ne P kupfuura kukosha kwaunoda. Kana imwe pfupi ikaonekwa, huumboo hwekuti mhedzisiro yakashata.
y-m-44-02.s.s2.o.e: Mhinduro yakabuda se irrational number √7, saka chimiro chekukosha chinoratidzika chisinganzwisisiki uye mhinduro inotongwa seyakashata
y-m-44-02.s.s2.r.e: Mwero unogona kuva irrational. Haugoni kusiyanisa chakarurama nechakashata nechimiro chekukosha oga.
y-m-44-02.s.s2.explain: Nzira b inoratidza zvakananga kuti mwero kuenda kutsoka ye perpendicular H(46/25, 153/25) ndi1.4. Nzira d inotora poinzi (2, 6) iri panzira, ine mwero kuenda ku P wa √2 ≈ 1.41, pfupi kupfuura √7 ≈ 2.65, izvo zvinoratidza kuti '√7 ndiwo mwero mupfupi zvakanyanya' hazvina kururama. Nzira mbiri idzi dzose dzinoshandisa nzira yakasiyana nemhinduro yekutanga, saka dzinotarisa mhedzisiro zvakazvimirira.
y-m-44-02.s.s3.prompt: Mwero wakarurama ndi 7/5 km. Tsvaga uye uise ma lattice points 3 akasiyana (x ne y dzose integers) asiri P(1, 5) ari pamwero wakaenzana (7/5 km) kubva kunzira l. Renji ndi 0 ≤ x ≤ 12, 0 ≤ y ≤ 10.

y-m-44-08.title: Mutsetse unodzoka pawakanga uri, saka sei denderedzwa risingagoni?
y-m-44-08.topic: Nyaya umo kutamisa kunoisa mutsetse kana denderedzwa pachazvo
y-m-44-08.goal: Enzanisa zvirevo zvezvimiro zvakatamiswa kuti utsvage mamiriro umo mutsetse unoisa pachawo (n = 2m), uye utsanangure kuti sei denderedzwa risina kutamisa kwakadaro.
y-m-44-08.material: Kana ukatamisa chimiro pacoordinate plane m kurudyi ne n kumusoro, poinzi yega yega yechimiro inofamba munzira imwe chete nechinhambwe chimwe chete. Ngatitamisei mutsetse y = 2x + 1 nedenderedzwa (x − 1)² + (y + 2)² = 9 uye titarise mhedzisiro.
y-m-44-08.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwokutanga: chirevo chinochinja sei pakutamisa (tsiva x ne x − m uye y ne y − n), slope yemutsetse, nepakati nepaanogara radius yedenderedzwa.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.prompt: Mhedzisiro dzemiedzo yokutamisa dzinoratidzwa rimwe panguva imwe. Nguva dzose, sarudza pfungwa inonzwisisika zvichienderana neruzivo rwakapfuura.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.hint.0: Pachikamu chega chega, enzanisa zvakananga mhedzisiro yokutamisa nechirevo chekutanga uye unyore kana zvakafanana kana zvakasiyana.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana ruzivo rutsva runochinja kutonga kwako. Kana rusingachinji, nyora chikonzero mumutsetse mumwe.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.info: Kana mutsetse y = 2x + 1 wakatamiswa 3 kurudyi ne 1 kumusoro, wakava y = 2x − 4. (Mutsetse wakasiyana nepamberi pokutamisa.)
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Zvinogoneka here kutamisa mutsetse uyu kuuisa pachawo nokutamisa?
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.after: Kungoti kutamisa kumwe kwakapa mutsetse wakasiyana, haugoni kuti kutamisa kwose kunodaro. Pane chikonzero chokuyedza kutamisa kumwe.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kutamisa nguva dzose kunoita kuti mutsetse uve mutsetse wakasiyana, saka zvinhu zvokuuisa pachawo hazvigoneki
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakati 'nguva dzose' kubva pamuedzo mumwe. Yedza zvakare nenzira yakasiyana yokutamisa.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvichienderana nenzira nechinhambwe chokutamisa, ungava mutsetse mumwe chete
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakanongedza kuti haufaniri kusungwa kumhedzisiro imwe uye unofanira kuyedza kutamisa kwakasiyana.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Mhedzisiro imwe iyi oga haitiudzi; tinofanira kuyedza kutamisa kwakasiyanawo
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku kutonga kwokumirira mhedziso uye kuita muedzo wakasiyana. Kunonzwisisika.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.info: Kana wakatamiswa 1 kurudyi ne 2 kumusoro, y − 2 = 2(x − 1) + 1, ndiko kuti, y = 2x + 1, saka wakava wakafanana nomutsetse wekutanga.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.ask: Wobva kana ukautamisa 2 kurudyi ne 4 kumusoro, uchava mutsetse mumwe chete zvakare here?
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana wakatamiswa ne (2, 4), y − 4 = 2(x − 2) + 1, ndiko kuti, y = 2x + 1, mutsetse mumwe chete zvakare. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti nzira yokutamisa (1, 2) yakafanana neslope 2 yemutsetse.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Kana chinhambwe chakatamiswa chakasiyana, mhedzisiro inosiyanawo, saka ichava mutsetse wakasiyana
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kunyange kana chinhambwe chakasiyana, kutamisa munzira yakafanana nemutsetse kunogona kupa mutsetse mumwe chete. Enzanisa nzira yokutamisa neslope yemutsetse.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ndimutsetse mumwe chete pa 1 kurudyi ne 2 kumusoro chete, uye hapana kumwe kutamisa kunoshanda
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: (2, 4), kaviri kutamisa (1, 2), ine nzira imwe chete. Iise uye utarise zvakananga.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zvinoratidzika kuti ichava mutsetse mumwe chete. Iise uye utarise zvakananga
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku kutonga kwokufungidzira mhedzisiro uye kuiyedza zvakananga.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.info: Kutamisa m kurudyi ne n kumusoro kunopa y = 2x − 2m + n + 1. Kuti ive imwe chete nomutsetse wekutanga y = 2x + 1, n = 2m inodikanwa. Ikozvino fungidzira kuti tinotamisa denderedzwa (x − 1)² + (y + 2)² = 9 m kurudyi ne n kumusoro.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kutamisa kupi (m, n) kunoisa denderedzwa pacharo?
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Pakati pedenderedzwa panofamba kubva ku (1, −2) kuenda ku (1 + m, −2 + n). Kuti denderedzwa rive rimwe chete, pakati panofanira kuva pamwe chete, saka (m, n) = (0, 0) chete. Mutsetse unoramba uri mutsetse mumwe chete kana wakatsvedzera nokutamisa munzira yawo pachawo, asi denderedzwa harina nzira yakadaro.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kutamisa ne n = 2m kunoita kuti denderedzwa rizviise pacharo, sezvaitwa nomutsetse, saka ndiro denderedzwa rimwe chete
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Tarisa zvinoitika kupakati pedenderedzwa. Zvakasiyana nomutsetse, denderedzwa haringi 'nzira' inofanana nenzira yokufamba.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.o.b: (0, 0) chete. Kutamisa kumwe kupi nokupi kunochinja pakati uye kunopa denderedzwa rakasiyana
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatonga nepakati neradius yedenderedzwa. Kunyange neradius imwe chete, pakati pakasiyana kunoreva denderedzwa rakasiyana.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Radius yakafanana, saka kutamisa kupi nokupi kunopa denderedzwa rimwe chete
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Radius yakafanana asi nzvimbo inochinja. Tarisa kuti pakati pedenderedzwa panoenda kupi.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Denderedzwa rakatenderera, saka pasinei nokuti rakasundwa kunzira ipi kana kure zvakadini, rinoramba riri pachaiyo
y-m-44-08.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kutenderera hakureve kuti rinozviisa pacharo. Enzanisa macoordinate epakati.
y-m-44-08.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga zviri nyore kufunga kuti 'kutamisa kunoita kuti mutsetse uve mutsetse wakasiyana'. Kufunga kwako kwakachinja sei zvichienderana nemhedzisiro dzemiedzo? Sei 'kutamisa kunoisa pachaiyo' kwakasiyana pamutsetse nepadenderedzwa?
y-m-44-08.s.s2.prompt: Pakati pekutamisa (m kurudyi, n kumusoro) kunoisa mutsetse y = 2x + 1 pachawo, gadzira uye uise 3 dzakasiyana, uchisiya nyaya yokusatamisa (m = 0). m ne n inhamba dzizere kubva pa −9 kusvika pa 9.
y-m-44-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora chirevo chakatamiswa muchimiro y = 2x + (chimwe chinhu) uye utsvage mamiriro anoita kuti y-intercept yacho ienzane neyemutsetse wekutanga.
y-m-44-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wawana peya imwe, yedzawo kutamisa kune nzira imwe asi chinhambwe chakasiyana.
y-m-44-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Mavharu akazara e m ne n anofanira kuva 9 kana kushoma.

y-m-44-08.s.s2.explain: Zvose zvine n = 2m zvinoshanda. Kutamisa kupi nokupi munzira imwe neslope 2 yemutsetse, se (1, 2), (2, 4), (−3, −6), (4, 8), kunopa mutsetse mumwe chete.
y-m-44-08.s.s2.because.prompt: Wakaudzwa kuti denderedzwa (x − 1)² + (y + 2)² = 9 harina kutamisa kunoriisa pachaiyo kunze kwe (0, 0). Enzanisa nomutsetse uye utsanangure chikonzero, uchitarisa pakati kana nzira.
y-m-44-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora zvinhu zviviri zvinofanira kuva zvakafanana kuti madenderedzwa ave akafanana.
y-m-44-08.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tsvaga kuti macoordinate epakati anoenda kupi kana denderedzwa ratamiswa ne (2, 4).
y-m-44-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakanongedza here misiyano pakati pemutsetse nedenderedzwa (mutsetse une nzira, denderedzwa rine pakati)?
y-m-44-08.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Chikonzero chako chinobatana here nokuti macoordinate epakati pedenderedzwa (1, −2) anoenda kupi?
y-m-44-08.s.s2.because.model.0: Pakati pedenderedzwa panofamba kubva ku (1, −2) kuenda ku (1 + m, −2 + n). Kana (m, n) isiri (0, 0), pakati panochinja uye rinova denderedzwa rakasiyana, saka hapana kunze kwe (0, 0). Mutsetse une nzira yokutsvedzera, asi denderedzwa harina.
y-m-44-08.s.s2.because.model.1: Mutsetse unozviputira kana wakatamiswa munzira yakafanana nawo pachawo, asi pakati pedenderedzwa panofamba kana rakasundwa munzira ipi neipi, saka haripindirani. Chete kana pakati pakafanana (kana pasingafambi) ndipo rakaenzana denderedzwa rimwe chete.

y-m-44-05.title: Nzira dzeshamwari mbiri dzekuwana poinzi yakaenzana: ndeipi iri yakarurama?
y-m-44-05.goal: Enzanisa nzira mbiri dzekuwana poinzi yakaenzana, ronga mamiriro apo nzira imwe neimwe inoshanda, uye ugadzire mapeya emapoinzi akaenzana.
y-m-44-05.material: Uyu i dambudziko rekuwana poinzi Q yaunowana nekuita reflection yepoinzi P(4, 1) kuyambuka mutsetse m : y = x + 1. Mayuniti akasiiwa.
y-m-44-05.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekare: kuwana poinzi yepakati yemapoinzi maviri, mamiriro ekuti mitsetse miviri ive perpendicular (ma slopes), nezvinoreva kuita reflection yepoinzi.
y-m-44-05.s.s1.prompt:
Unoda kuwana poinzi Q yawakawana nekuita reflection yepoinzi P(4, 1) kuyambuka mutsetse m : y = x + 1. Wakaenzanisa nzira dzeshamwari mbiri.
하늘 : "Kuita reflection kuyambuka y = x kunoreva kushandurana x-coordinate ne y-coordinate. Saka Q i (1, 4)."
다온 : "Sarudza Q kuti PQ isangane ne m pa right angle uye poinzi yepakati ye PQ ive pa m."
Kutonga kupi pamusoro penzira mbiri kunokodzera zvikuru?
y-m-44-05.s.s1.hint.0: Wana poinzi yepakati ye Q(1, 4) ye 하늘 ne P(4, 1), uye uiise mu equation yemutsetse m.
y-m-44-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora mamiriro maviri ana 다온 (perpendicular, poinzi yepakati) se ma equations, wana a ne b dze Q(a, b), uye uienzanise nepoinzi ya 하늘.
y-m-44-05.s.s1.o.a: Nzira ya 하늘 inogona kushandiswa chero mutsetse une chimiro chipi, saka Q(1, 4) i yakarurama
y-m-44-05.s.s1.r.a: Edza kana nzira yekushandurana x- ne y-coordinates inoshandawo kumutsetse uyu nekutarisa kana poinzi yepakati ye P ne Q(1, 4) iri pa m.
y-m-44-05.s.s1.o.b: Nzira mbiri dzose dzinogona kushandiswa, uye mapoinzi adzinopa akafanana
y-m-44-05.s.s1.r.b: Verenga zvakananga kuenzanisa kana nzira mbiri dzinopa poinzi imwechete. Unogona kuziva nekutarisa kana poinzi yekudivi rimwe ichigutsa mamiriro.
y-m-44-05.s.s1.o.c: Kana mutsetse usiri y = x, hapana nzira yekusarudza poinzi yakaitwa reflection
y-m-44-05.s.s1.r.c: Kunyange kana mutsetse usiri y = x, pane mamiriro anosarudza poinzi. Tarisa kuti nzira ipi yeshamwari mbiri inoshandisa mamiriro.
y-m-44-05.s.s1.o.d: Nzira ya 다온 inofanira kushandiswa, uye nzira ya 하늘 inoshanda kana mutsetse i y = x chete
y-m-44-05.s.s1.r.d: Wakaronga nzira zvichibva pazvinoreva reflection (perpendicular nepoinzi yepakati). Wakaratidzawo kuti nzira ya 하늘 inoshanda rini.
y-m-44-05.s.s1.explain: Poinzi Q yakaitwa reflection inogutsa 'PQ i perpendicular kumutsetse' ne 'poinzi yepakati ye PQ i pamutsetse'. Kugadzirisa nemamiriro ana 다온 kunopa Q(0, 5). Q(1, 4) ya 하늘 ine poinzi yepakati (2.5, 2.5), uye poinzi iyi haisi pa y = x + 1, saka i yakaipa. Nzira ya 하늘 yakarurama kana mutsetse i y = x chete.
y-m-44-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya emapoinzi akaenzana kuyambuka mutsetse m : y = x + 1. Taura poinzi ine x-coordinate diki se (p, q) neine x-coordinate hombe se (r, s), uye ese i ma integers kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 10. Isa mapeya 3 akasiyana.
y-m-44-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza ma coordinates (p, q) epoinzi imwe, uye uwane expression inonyora ma coordinates epoinzi yakaenzana uchishandisa p ne q. Tanga wasarudza peya imwe iwe pachako uye utarise poinzi yepakati ne slope.
y-m-44-05.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kana mutemo wawakawana uchishandawo kune mamwe mapeya nekutarisa kana poinzi yepakati iri pa m.
y-m-44-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba ina dzese dzinofanira kuva kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 10.
y-m-44-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Nyora poinzi ine x-coordinate diki se (p, q).
y-m-44-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Mapoinzi maviri akaenzana kuyambuka mutsetse m.
y-m-44-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Gadzirisa ma coordinates kuti poinzi yepakati yemapoinzi maviri ive pa m uye mutsetse unoabatanidza ive perpendicular ku m.
y-m-44-05.s.s2.explain: Mapoinzi akaenzana i (p, q) ne (q − 1, p + 1). Semuenzaniso, kune (0, 5) ne (4, 1), poinzi yepakati (2, 3) i pa m, uye slope yemutsetse unobatanidza mapoinzi maviri i −1, saka i perpendicular ku m. Iyi i expression yaunowana nekushandurana x ne y sezvakaita 하늘 wobva wagadzirisa ne 1.
y-m-44-05.s.s3.prompt: Nyora kuti nzira ya 하늘 (kushandurana x-coordinate ne y-coordinate) i yakarurama kumutsetse wemhando ipi, uye utsanangure, uchishandisa P(4, 1) ne Q(1, 4), kuti sei isiri yakarurama kumutsetse m mudambudziko iri.
y-m-44-05.s.s3.hint.0: Wana ma coordinates epoinzi yepakati ye P ne Q(1, 4) uye utarise kana poinzi iyoyo ichigutsa equation yemutsetse m.
y-m-44-05.s.s3.hint.1: Chinja mutsetse kuita y = x, shandisa nzira imwechete, uye uenzanise kuti chii chinochinja.

y-m-44-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa nenhamba humbowo hwawakashandisa (sepoinzi yepakati) here?
y-m-44-05.s.s3.model.0: Nzira ya 하늘 i yakarurama kana mutsetse i y = x chete. Poinzi yepakati ye P(4, 1) ne Q(1, 4) i (2.5, 2.5), asi mutsetse m : y = x + 1 une mapoinzi chete apo y i 1 yakakura kupfuura x, saka poinzi iyi haisi pa m. Saka haana kuenzana.
y-m-44-05.s.s3.model.1: Kushandurana x ne y kunopa poinzi yakaenzana kuyambuka y = x. m i mutsetse y = x wakafambiswa kumusoro ne 1, saka unofanira kufambisa kamwe zvakare. Madhuri kubva ku P ne Q(1, 4) kuenda ku m haaenzani, saka poinzi ya 하늘 i yakaipa.

y-m-44-01.title: Nzvimbo ine daro rakafanana kubva kumadhokisi maviri yechikepe chekununura
y-m-44-01.topic: Seti yemapoinzi ane daro rakafanana kubva kumapoinzi maviri (perpendicular bisector yesegment)
y-m-44-01.goal: Wana mapoinzi nemaoko kuongorora kuti mapoinzi ari kure zvakaenzana kubva kumapoinzi maviri haagadzire poinzi imwe asi mutsetse, uye utsanangure nemaequation kuti nei achigadzira mutsetse.
y-m-44-01.material: Pane madhokisi maviri egungwa. Pacoordinate plane (1 square = 1 km), dhokisi A riri pa (0, 0) uye dhokisi B riri pa (6, 2). Kuti chikepe chekununura chimhanye daro rakafanana chero dhokisi ripi rine ngozi, unoda kuchiisa panzvimbo ine daro rakafanana kubva kumadhokisi ose maviri.

Fungidzira kuti mudzidzi akatodzidza maequation emichimiro (mitsetse nemadenderedzwa) muCommon Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro.
y-m-44-01.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekutanga: maitiro ekuwana daro pakati pemapoinzi maviri pacoordinate plane, uye kuenzanisa mitaurire miviri nekuiwedzera.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.prompt: Fungidzira unomaka poinzi imwe neimwe egungwa ine daro rakafanana kubva kumadhokisi ose maviri A neB. Mapoinzi iwayo pamwe chete anogadzira chimiro chipi?
y-m-44-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza poinzi imwe kunze kwe (3, 1), pakati pesegment AB, uye unyore daro rayo kuA nedaro rayo kuB. (Muenzaniso: (2, 4))
y-m-44-01.s.s1.hint.1: Wana mapoinzi matatu kana mana, uaise pacoordinate plane, uye utarise kuti anoenderana pachimiro chipi.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.o.a: Pakati pe segment AB chete, uye hapana imwe poinzi
y-m-44-01.s.s1.r.a: Pakati ndiyo imwe chete yemapoinzi ari pamwero wakaenzana. Sarudza imwe poinzi zvakare uye uenzanise mwero wayo kuenda ku A ne B.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.o.b: Denderedzwa rine pakati A rinopfuura ne B
y-m-44-01.s.s1.r.b: Poinzi iri padenderedzwa iri iri pamwero wakaenzana ne A chete. Mubvunzo uyu, mwero kuenda kuna A naB zvose unofanira kuenzana.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.o.c: Mutsara mumwe unopfuura nepakati pe segment AB
y-m-44-01.s.s1.r.c: Unogona kuedza kufanofungidzira uku nekuisa mapoinzi mashoma uye kutarisa kuti anoronga muchimiro chipi.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.o.d: Mutsara wekubva kumadhoko maviri A naB
y-m-44-01.s.s1.r.d: Mapoinzi ari pamutsara AB anowanzova padhuze nedhoko rimwe. Enzanisa mwero miviri uchishandisa mapoinzi mashoma ari paari.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.explain: Mapoinzi ari pamwero wakaenzana kubva ku A ne B anosanganisira kwete pakati (3, 1) pe segment AB chete asi nemapoinzi ari kure senge (2, 4). Mapoinzi aya ari pamutsara unopfuura nepakati pe AB uye unosangana ne AB nekona yakarurama (perpendicular bisector ye segment AB). Uku kungova kufanofungidzira parizvino; mudanho rinotevera uchatsvaga mapoinzi iwe pachako kuti utarise.
y-m-44-01.s.s2.prompt: Pa coordinate plane, kurudyi (kumabvazuva) ndi x uye kumusoro (kuchamhembe) ndi y. Madhoko ndi A(0, 0) ne B(6, 2), uye 1 square ndi 1 km. Mamiriro: unogona kushandisa gungwa rine x ≥ 0 ne y ≥ 0 chete, poinzi iri pamwero wakaenzana kubva ku A ne B, uye iri mukati me 10 km kubva ku A. Tsvaga uye uise nzvimbo 3 dzakasiyana.
y-m-44-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kana wasarudza poinzi, nyora square yemwero kuenda ku A, x² + y², uye square yemwero kuenda ku B zvakaparadzana, uye uenzanise makosha maviri.

y-m-44-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Mwero kuenda ku A nemwero kuenda ku B zvakasiyana. Enzanisa ma squares avo.

y-m-44-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Iri kure kupfuura 10 km kubva ku A.

y-m-44-01.s.s3.prompt: Mapoinzi awakawana ari pamutsara mumwe. Mapoinzi mashoma anoratidzika semutsara mutsetse haakwani kutaura kuti mapoinzi ose akadaro anoita mutsara. y-m-44-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tora poinzi P(x, y) uye unyore equation inoita kuti square yemwero kubva ku P kuenda ku A ienzane nesquare yemwero kubva ku P kuenda ku B.

y-m-44-04.title: Nguva apo triangle inoumbwa nemitsara mitatu inonyangarika
y-m-44-04.topic: Nzvimbo dzemitsara mitatu (kusangana papoinzi imwe, kufanana) nemamiriro ekuumba triangle
y-m-44-04.goal: Dzokorora nyaya apo mitsara mitatu isingagoni kuumba triangle (kufanana, kusangana papoinzi imwe) nenhevedzano apo ruzivo runoratidzwa, uye upfupise mhedziso yekukosha kwe k kwega kwega.
y-m-44-04.material: Pane mitsara mitatu l₁ : y = x + 1, l₂ : y = −x + 5, l₃ : 2x − y = k. k ndi constant. Zvichienderana nekukosha kwe k, mitsara mitatu inogona kuvhara triangle kana kuti kwete. Nzira yekuverenga: l₃ ndi 'two x minus y equals k'.
y-m-44-04.thinking.2: Kutsvaga nyaya yakasiyana uye kutsanangura nei
y-m-44-04.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekutanga: kutsvaga kusangana kwemitsara miviri, nekutsvaga area ye triangle kubva kuma coordinates emakona ayo matatu (uchishandisa base ne height kana ma coordinates).
y-m-44-04.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo rwemitsara mitatu runoratidzwa rumwe panguva padanho rimwe nerimwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kufunga kunonzwisisika neruzivo rwekusvika zvino.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, nyora kuti ruzivo rutsva rwakaratidzwa runochinja chikamu chipi che 'mamiriro ekuti triangle iumbwe'.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana zvakanaka kuchengeta sarudzo imwe chete kana kuti unofanira kuchinja chikonzero.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Pane mitsara mitatu. l₁ : y = x + 1 (slope 1), l₂ : y = −x + 5 (slope −1), l₃ : 2x − y = k (slope 2, k ndi constant isati yagadziriswa). Ma slopes emitsara mitatu ose akasiyana, saka hapana mitsara miviri yakafanana.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Chero nhamba ipi k, mitsara mitatu haina kufanana. Saka, chero k iri chii, mitsara mitatu inoumba triangle here?
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kusava nemitsara yakafanana ndiro rimwe chete remamiriro ekuti triangle iumbwe. Pangava, zvichienderana ne k, nenzira imwe yekuti triangle isaumbwa (mitsara mitatu ichisangana papoinzi imwe), saka unofanira kutarisa.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Mitsara mitatu haina kufanana, saka triangle inoumbwa chero k iri chii

y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaratidza kuti 'kusafanana' oga hakupedzisi mhedziso. Chasara kuwana kuti nyaya dzipi ndidzo dambudziko.

y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ma slopes emitsetse mitatu akasiyana: 1, −1, 2, saka haagone kuva mutsetse mumwechete.
